claims.text: In an interim order dated 4 June 2026, the Tribunal judiciaire de Caen ordered Carrefour France to provide e-commerce services complying with French accessibility requirements. A €500 daily penalty applies if non-compliance continues six months after the order. The court also ordered Carrefour to pay a total of €10,000 in provisional damages to apiDV and Droit Pluriel, the costs of the proceedings, and €3,000 under article 700 of the French Code of Civil Procedure.
claims.legal_basis: Consumer Code L.412-13; order of 9 October 2023; CPC Article 700.
claims.stage_detail: Stage is limited to the dated source; no later outcome inferred.

sources.reference: Court order 4 June 2026, RG 25/00691, pp.1 and 7–8
sources.passage: The interim order requires Carrefour France to provide accessible e-commerce services under Consumer Code L.412-13 and the 9 October 2023 order. A EUR500 daily penalty applies six months after pronouncement. It awards the associations EUR10,000 provisionally, costs of these proceedings, and EUR3,000 under CPC Article 700.
sources.provenance_note: Court-document copy hosted by an association involved in the case, not a court-hosted download. Original scan pp.1 and 8 visually inspected; legal reasoning and operative text read. Court document distinguished from the host’s interpretation.
